title: Deliveries faced (excluding wides; no-balls included)
definition: Count each delivery recorded with the player as striker unless extras.wides>0. No-balls are included. This is an explicitly defined historical count, not a claim about an official scorecard balls-faced convention.
eligibility: Men ODI, match start >=2016-01-01, no-result matches excluded, observed ordinary innings only, D/L retained.
dnb: Rostered players never observed as batter/non-striker/dismissed are excluded. Observed non-strikers who never face a qualifying delivery remain zero, not DNB.
position: Order of first batter/non-striker appearance, with dismissed-player fallback. Opening pair combined because first striker/non-striker does not establish certified batting order. Position12 retained separately for concussion-substitute innings.
comparisons: Disjoint NZ venues versus Outside NZ; all teams. NZ membership uses existing audited exact-venue crosswalk. Outside NZ is the complement.
chart: Boxes 25th to75th percentiles; median centre; whiskers5th to95th percentiles; outliers hidden. n is observed individual batting innings. Middle/lower aggregates are extra CSV rows.
interpretation: Exploratory historical opportunity distribution; innings within matches are dependent; team, era, chase, rain, selection and ability confound comparisons. No model fit or predictive claim.
